Scope (routes under app/api/cyrus/ and their libs under lib/cyrus/ and lib/modbuilder/):
1. app/api/cyrus/delivery/v1/** , lib/cyrus/delivery/** , lib/modbuilder/delivery.ts : ownership checks (can user A enqueue delivery to user B's server or B's build/pack?), idempotency (double-submit creating duplicate jobs / double restart), restart abuse (unbounded restarts, no rate limit), path traversal in any file path written to a game server (names, keys, filenames from user input or from ModSpec/pack contents reaching remote paths).
2. app/api/cyrus/modpacks/v1/** , lib/cyrus/modpack/** : same checks (ownership of every member build/pack, install/uninstall on someone else's server).
3. app/api/cyrus/config/v1, app/api/cyrus/datapacks/v1, app/api/cyrus/designer/v1/** , lib/cyrus/config, lib/cyrus/datapack, lib/cyrus/designer, lib/cyrus/motion, and the generator in services/modbuilder (designs.js, designer-spec.js, datapacks.js, any Java/YAML/JSON emitters): can user-controlled strings (names, ids, lore, messages, commands, keys, namespaces) inject into generated Java source (string escaping, unicode escapes like " which javac processes BEFORE lexing!), YAML (newline/colon injection), JSON, mcfunction (newline -> extra command), file names (../)? Is there a Zod schema with a strict id regex? Check unicode-escape handling especially for Java.
4. Does each route check the auth session + the feature flag and fail closed when the flag is off?

For each finding give: severity (high/medium/low/info), file:line, a concrete trace (input -> code path -> effect), "VERIFIED by reading" or "UNVERIFIED (why)", and a minimal fix suggestion. Also list things you checked that are SAFE (one line each) so the audit can claim coverage. Keep the whole report under 800 words.

input.message:
AUDIT REPORT (read-only; nothing run). No high-severity cross-tenant issue found in delivery, modpacks, config, datapacks or designer.

FINDINGS

1. MEDIUM. Java source injection through Javadoc comments in the designer compiler. VERIFIED by reading.
- Sites: lib/cyrus/designer/compile.ts:331 (ability name), gameplay/compile.ts:265 (menu title) and :350 (quest title), boss/compile.ts:305 (boss name) and :393 (encounter title). The same code is bundled 5 times in services/modbuilder/designer-spec.js.
- Pattern: `/** Ability "${ab.name.replace(/\*\//g, "")}" ... */`.
- Trace: the `Text()` schema (lib/cyrus/designer/spec.ts:89) forbids only control characters and §. Backslash, `*` and `/` are allowed.
  - The input `**//` loses its inner `*/` and becomes a reformed `*/`, which closes the comment.
  - `*/` also closes it, because javac decodes unicode escapes before lexing. Nothing in the designer handles `\u`.
  - Code after the close lands at top level of the generated .java file. Include a trailing `/*` so the real `*/` still balances.
  - Entry points: PUT draft or POST revisions, then POST builds (the no-model designEdit path).
- Bound on impact: services/modbuilder/server.js runs scanBytecode on the compiled classes and scanSource on src/main/java. I did not confirm the designEdit path calls both. Impact is therefore likely limited to scanner-bypass attempts and build breakage.
- Fix: drop the user text from comments, or emit `name.replace(/[^\w ]/g, "")`. Also reject `\` in `Text()` where it is not needed.

2. MEDIUM. Mod Pack install skips the single-mod install gates. VERIFIED by reading.
- Files: lib/cyrus/modpack/api.ts:handleInstall (about line 205) and lib/modbuilder/modpack.ts.
- Trace: pack install calls only `checkServer`, which checks server ownership, compatibility and ENABLE_REAL_GAMEMODS.
  - It never runs `capabilityGate`, so the networking-off switch and the capability-consent sha are bypassed. Compare lib/modbuilder/delivery.ts:checkInstall.
  - It never runs `flightBlocks`, so the Test Flight block is bypassed. Compare lib/modbuilder/install.ts:115.
  - It never runs `installPlansFor` or `confirmPlan`. The header comment says this one is an owner decision.
- Effect: a networking-capable or flight-blocked build can reach a server through a pack when the admin setting `cyrus_mod_networking_enabled` is off.
- Fix: in `members()` and again in the worker's modpack branch, apply `capabilityGate` and `flightBlocks` per member build, and refuse members that fail.

3. LOW. Restart and rate limits on the modpack routes. VERIFIED by reading.
- Pack install and uninstall use only MODPACK_RATE_LIMITS (10/min, 120/hr, lib/cyrus/modpack/api.ts:50). They do not use DELIVERY_RATE_LIMITS (6/min, 40/hr). The only real brake is the per-server one-job lock.
- Nothing enforces a per-server cooldown or restart budget on either route.
- A user can loop install and uninstall to restart their own server roughly once a minute, all day. That is a self-DoS and worker load, not a cross-tenant issue.
- The limiter is in-memory (lib/rate-limit.ts), so each web instance counts separately.
- Fix: apply the delivery buckets to pack install and uninstall. Add a per-server restart cap, for example N per hour.

4. LOW. No quota on stored packs. VERIFIED by reading.
- `handleCreate` writes a pack archive of up to 30 embedded jars per call (lib/cyrus/modpack/store.ts). The limit is 120 per hour, with no per-user pack count or byte cap. Repeated POSTs also create duplicate packs, since there is no idempotency.
- Fix: add a per-user pack count and byte quota.

5. LOW / UNVERIFIED. mcfunction trailing-backslash continuation.
- lib/cyrus/datapack/functions.ts:221-226 rejects line breaks, `$` macros and a leading `/`. It does not reject a command ending in `\`.
- In Minecraft 1.20.2 and later the game joins such a line with the next one, while the validator checks each entry alone. I could not build a bypass, because the merged command keeps the first entry's allowlisted root. I did not test whether `execute ... run \` alone validates.
- Fix: refuse any entry that ends in `\`.

6. INFO. A reused Idempotency-Key with a different body returns the old job. VERIFIED by reading.
- The client key hash covers only user and key, not the request body (lib/cyrus/delivery/request.ts:deliveryKey). The response `reused: true` then carries a `parts` view for the new request next to the old job's status.
- Fix: include a hash of the request body in the key.

7. INFO. Config Java exporter has the same `*/` comment bug. VERIFIED by reading.
- `p.label.replace(/\*\//g, "")` at lib/cyrus/config/exporters.ts:~110 is bypassable the same way. Labels use `line()`, which has no character restriction.
- Dead in production: `javaSettingsClass` is only referenced by tests and scripts. services/modbuilder/configs.js uses only `verifyTunables`.

8. INFO. Designer build double-submit race. VERIFIED by reading.
- lib/cyrus/designer/studio/service.ts:buildRevision does its `prev` check without a lock, so two concurrent POSTs can create two builds.
- This is bounded by `createDesignerBuild`: 3/min, 20/hr and a MAX_INFLIGHT cap, and no model tokens are spent.

SAFE (checked)

Delivery and ownership
- Delivery POST: flag, then session, then rate limit, then input, then ownership.
  - A build ID is looked up with `{id, userId}` and checked again. An uninstall projectId is looked up with `{id, userId}`.
  - A server ID is checked in `checkInstall`/`checkServer`, and again under `withServerJobLock` (`srv.userId`, not DELETING).
  - No A-to-B path found.
- Job status and list queries filter on `server: {userId}` and the delivery marker.
- The worker (lib/cyrus/delivery/job.ts) re-checks all of these:
  - the delivery flag is on;
  - `requestedBy` matches the server owner;
  - the build or project belongs to the server owner;
  - the pack store is per user.
- Double-click and double-submit of a delivery: the derived key reuses a job only while it is QUEUED or RUNNING, the advisory lock serialises, `inflight>0` returns 409 busy, and a busy ServerMod row returns 409. Unchanged deliveries and uninstalls do not restart (orchestrator.ts:397 and :466).
- Delivery rate limits are 6/min and 40/hr per user. The enqueue path writes an audit row.

Paths written to the game server
- `verifyRelease` enforces:
  - the jar name matches `^[A-Za-z0-9._ -]{1,120}\.jar$` with no `/`;
  - the namespace matches `^nx_[a-z0-9]{8}$`;
  - the datapack name matches `^[a-z0-9_-]{1,40}$`.
- The level name is sanitised in worker/cyrus-delivery.ts:131. Creature model paths are re-validated and recompiled with a sha check.
- Mod Pack manifest paths pass `SERVER_PATH_RE` (manifest.ts:22), which has no `/` or `..` beyond the fixed shapes. The pack archive rejects unsafe entry names and is verified by sha256. Pack store paths use a strict userId and packId regex.

Modpack ownership

- Trace: pack install calls only `checkServer`, which checks server ownership, compatibility and ENABLE_REAL_GAMEMODS.

- Nothing enforces a per-server cooldown or restart budget on either route.
- A user can loop install and uninstall to restart their own server roughly once a minute, all day. That is a self-DoS and worker load, not a cross-tenant issue.
